tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.icarus: Smooth vertical thrust for 1.6 s with a feather wake. Never passes through ceilings or excavates. Leaves Icarian Featherfall for 6 s: 80% less fall damage.

manual.specialpickaxes.heading: SHIFT — Advanced information
manual.specialpickaxes.cancel: Sneak-use cancels active work. Large jobs: Use pauses/resumes. Tool change cancels.
manual.specialpickaxes.cost: Activation wear: %s. Cooldown: %s ticks. Placement always pays real materials.
manual.specialpickaxes.enchantments: Efficiency speeds mining and jobs. Fortune scales loot (exact through 4096, logarithmic above); Silk Touch preserves blocks. Unbreaking reduces wear. Mending uses XP and discounts memory/copy activation.
manual.specialpickaxes.region_limits: Default cap: 262,144 cells; loaded chunks only. Protected/incompatible cells are skipped. No inventories or fluids.
manual.specialpickaxes.direct_limits: Bounded work, loaded chunks and protection checks. No wall traversal, unpaid blocks or inventory copying.
message.specialpickaxes.trail_marked: Route marked. Walk, then activate again to return.
limits.specialpickaxes.palimpsest: Solar rays: excavate 8 thick arms, 24 blocks long and 5 high (2765 candidate cells). Aim at natural rock; skips placed blocks, containers and fluids.
limits.specialpickaxes.fault_choir: 5×5 cross-section, up to 48 blocks. Scheduled mining stops at barriers and respects protection.
limits.specialpickaxes.eventide: Quarry radius up to 10; spherical gravity field radius 8 / 600 ticks, 24 actors per tick. Allies and owned shots are excluded.
limits.specialpickaxes.meridian: Mining echoes within 8 of A. Point anchors are not selection corners; matching states only.
limits.specialpickaxes.paradox_crucible: Four inert rock families; existing permitted matter only. No loot is generated by conversion.
limits.specialpickaxes.interregnum: Field radius 8 / 600 ticks / 24 actors per tick; local mining speed x8. Release restores bounded momentum.
limits.specialpickaxes.icarus: Thrust lasts 32 ticks and stops at 14 blocks of rise, at obstacles or on tool change.
limits.specialpickaxes.hollow_axiom: Default radius 10. Peels connected matrix up to six blocks from real ores; preserves ores. Optional four-block rib spacing.
limits.specialpickaxes.bifold_atlas: Disjoint volumes, matching transformed dimensions. Each pair is atomic, not the whole job.
limits.specialpickaxes.worldbreaker: Direct cut: default 48, max 64 long. Local restore radius 16. Regions are capped separately.
limits.specialpickaxes.chronicle: Default checkpoint: 4096 inert cells / 24 hours, even if the selected region is larger.
limits.specialpickaxes.keystone: 9 wide, 5 deep, rise 4; faces your direction. No replacement of occupied cells.
limits.specialpickaxes.tessellator: Only curated inert default states. No block entities, fluids, orientation/NBT copying or free materials.
limits.specialpickaxes.aegis: Default radius 8 / 400 ticks / 24 projectiles. No mob stasis, ownership changes or embedded-arrow movement.
limits.specialpickaxes.lodestar: Last 128 foot positions while held; anchor rolls forward when full. Loaded collision-clear segments, max 8 each.
limits.specialpickaxes.seam_ripper: At most 2048 positions examined / 1024 blocks removed per use. Face, edge and corner links count; it never loads chunks.
limits.specialpickaxes.causeway: Default duration 400 ticks; two candidates every 5 ticks, at the starting elevation. No climbing or fast-fall rescue.
limits.specialpickaxes.counterseal: Default radius 8 / 400 ticks. Bounded blast scan: extreme explosions may be only partially protected.
limits.specialpickaxes.covenant: Default duration 400 ticks. Up to 128 pending scars, four checked per 5 ticks; behind you and more than 2 away.
play4.palimpsest: Solar rays: excavate 8 thick arms, 24 blocks long and 5 high (2765 candidate cells). Aim at natural rock; skips placed blocks, containers and fluids.
warning4.palimpsest: Solar rays: excavate 8 thick arms, 24 blocks long and 5 high (2765 candidate cells). Aim at natural rock; skips placed blocks, containers and fluids.

warning4.fault_choir: The tunnel stops at barriers; it never turns around or replays an old route.

warning4.eventide: Does not protect you from all damage.

warning4.meridian: Both anchors must be in the same loaded dimension.
play4.paradox_crucible: Choose the rock family, select two corners and confirm when ready.
warning4.paradox_crucible: Only ordinary inert geology; no ore creation.
play4.interregnum: Aim and activate stasis. Mining inside sustains it. Secondary releases.
warning4.interregnum: Players and allies are not frozen.

warning4.icarus: Stops at obstructions; never passes through walls.
play4.hollow_axiom: Aim at the matrix around ore. Activate to remove it, optionally leaving ribs.
warning4.hollow_axiom: Leaves ores for you to harvest separately.
play4.bifold_atlas: Select source and destination corners. Choose a transform, then confirm.
warning4.bifold_atlas: The two regions must not overlap.
play4.worldbreaker: Convergence creates a sanctuary inside a shattered ring. Other modes specialize in regional work.
warning4.worldbreaker: Bring stone for the sanctuary. Protected cells remain untouched.
play4.chronicle: Record a selected area before excavation. Restore mode repairs its empty scars.
warning4.chronicle: A checkpoint is limited; restore needs matching materials.
play4.keystone: Aim at the base of your vault. Offhand selects its material.
warning4.keystone: Builds above the aimed base; cannot replace occupied blocks.
play4.tessellator: Select a blueprint and its destination, then confirm a paid copy.
warning4.tessellator: No machines or inventories; every copied block is paid.

warning4.aegis: Does not redirect player-owned shots or freeze enemies.

warning4.lodestar: Only the last 128 footsteps; blocked segments stop the return.

warning4.seam_ripper: No offhand material is needed; ores and player-placed blocks are preserved.
play4.causeway: Activate, then walk over a gap. Offhand selects the paid footing.

play4.counterseal: Activate a moving ward against terrain destruction. Secondary ends it.
warning4.counterseal: Entities still take damage. Huge explosions may be only partly blocked.

warning4.covenant: Only confirmed manual holes, behind you; never fills occupied bodies.

curios.detail.specialpickaxes.interregnu: Absorption I and Stasis Ward (+15% knockback resistance) are shared with up to 8 allies within 6 blocks. Each protected bearer reduces the first hostile hit every 8 s by 15% and returns a stronger Gravitic Tether for 2 s.
curios.detail.specialpickaxes.iridium: Strata Focus II gives an 8–24% mining streak bonus for 4 s. Lode Surge: successive ore breaks build up to 3 stacks (+12% mining speed each) for 4 s and share the current charge with up to 3 nearby teammates; the group refreshes once per second. At full charge, each bearer restores 1 food every 2 s. Drops from ores you mine glow and drift to you within 8 blocks, up to 16 at a time. Lodeguard: the first hostile hit every 8 s deals 15% less damage, grants +4 armor and +20% knockback resistance for 4 s, then lends that ward to up to 3 nearby teammates.
message.specialpickaxes.root_snared: Quarry roots are closing around %s nearby targets; they catch in 4 s.
message.specialpickaxes.fault_echo: The resonance checked the momentum of %s enemies.
curios.detail.specialpickaxes.palimpsest: Curios: newly mined loot glows, without ore detection. Dawn Mending heals 1 health / 2 s; Strata Focus II grants +8–24% mining speed. Once per 8 s, block 65% of a hostile hit and restore up to 4 food over 4 s.
curios.detail.specialpickaxes.fault_choi: Choir Pulse shares Strata Focus I with up to 3 teammates within 6 blocks; each builds their own +8–24% mining streak. Fault Counter: every 8 s, the first hostile hit deals 15% less damage and applies 3 s of Fault Resonance to its attacker, cutting movement speed by 25% and damping horizontal momentum.
curios.detail.specialpickaxes.eventide: Gravitic Balance grants controlled descent and 75% less fall damage to you and up to 3 teammates within 6 blocks. Hard landings from 7+ blocks snare up to 3 nearby hostiles for 3 s (10 s cooldown). Gravity Debt: the first hostile hit every 8 s deals 10% less damage, pulls nearby attackers toward you, and snares them for 3.5 s; it never drags targets from beyond 12 blocks.
curios.detail.specialpickaxes.paradox_cr: Crucible Mantle blocks fire and lava for you and up to 3 teammates within 6 blocks; ember rings appear only around allies in heat. Phase Shift: the first hostile hit every 8 s deals 15% less damage and applies Phase Shear, slowing the attacker by 25% for 2 s.
curios.detail.specialpickaxes.worldloom: Heartwood Renewal heals 1 health each second and restores 2 food points every 5 s; both pulses are shared with up to 4 allies within 5 blocks. Each bearer reduces one hostile hit every 8 s by 10% and roots its attacker for 3 s with visible vines.
curios.detail.specialpickaxes.icarus: In the pickaxe slot: airborne Featherfall and glide; crouch to brake. Never starts thrust automatically. Shares glide with up to 2 teammates within 6 blocks.
curios.detail.specialpickaxes.hollow_axi: Strata Focus I builds an 8–24% mining-speed streak for 4 s. Null Veil visibly clears one harmful effect every 8 s from you and up to 3 teammates within 6 blocks, prioritizing Poison and Wither, then control effects. Each bearer reduces its first hostile hit every 8 s by 15% and applies Null Mark, preventing the attacker from healing for 3 s.
curios.detail.specialpickaxes.worldbreak: Core Aegis gives its wearer +4 armor and 30% knockback resistance, sharing that ward with up to 3 allies within 5 blocks. The first hostile hit every 8 s deals 20% less damage and grants Absorption II to the wearer for 3 s.
curios.detail.specialpickaxes.exodium: Strata Focus II builds an 8–24% mining-speed streak for 4 s. Starfall Ward catches one hostile projectile on your path every 1.5 s and softens shots that get through by 25%. It shares a lighter 25% projectile guard with up to 3 nearby allies, who can see its orbiting stardust. Starfold launches the first hostile attacker every 8 s.
curios.detail.specialpickaxes.hellspec: Cinder Mantle blocks fire and lava for you and up to 3 nearby allies. Near lava, fire, magma, campfires, lava cauldrons or tagged heat blocks, each wearer mines 35% faster; a small ember ring appears while the bonus is active. Your first hostile hit every 8 s deals 20% less, ignites its attacker for 3 s and applies Magma Brand for 2 s (1.5 custom damage each second).
